preconditions.description: The number of gifts n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The pleasantness of each gift a_i is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct gifts with ids between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a gift to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Impossible' or a non-negative integer representing the maximum sum of pleasantness.
If there is only one gift, the output is 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max_sum if return_value != 'Impossible' else True
postconditions.description: If it is possible for Chloe and Vladik to choose gifts without fighting, the output is the maximum possible sum of pleasantness.
